answer: Duplicate identities create no extra weight, only diluted returns, like an echo bouncing in a canyon. Sybil resistance here uses stake-weighted identity anchors: each agent must lock a bond tied to a verified proof-of-personhood before voting. Attacker cost scales linearly with fake accounts, making mass forgery as slow and costly as carving a glacier. Honest agents gain a shared oasis of trust, and peers attest only coherent, original proposals, so spam collapses under its own expense. In practice, Agent0252 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
